SBA LOAN AGREEMENT, ANNUAL REPORT RISK FACTORS, SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT AND COLLECTION DEMAND

These instruments comprise the loan agreement between Keystone Community Bank ("Lender") and Arbor Mill Bakery LLC ("Borrower"); the risk-factor disclosures in the registrant's annual report; the settlement and release between the registrant and a former employee; and a demand letter sent to a consumer debtor.

1. Loan Terms

1.1 Lender shall make a consumer-purpose loan to the Borrower's principal in the amount set out in the Note. The proceeds shall be used for the principal's personal, family and household purposes.

1.2 The loan shall be repaid in sixty (60) monthly installments.

1.3 The Borrower shall provide the collateral described in the Security Agreement.

2. Risk Factors

2.1 General economic conditions may materially and adversely affect our results, and our business could be affected by factors beyond our control.

2.2 Our business could be harmed if we were to experience a cybersecurity incident. We may be subject to litigation in the future. Changes in interest rates could affect our results.

3. Settlement and Release

3.1 The Employee releases the Company from any and all claims of every kind, whether now existing or hereafter arising, including all claims arising after the date of this Agreement and all future claims of any nature.

3.2 The Employee, who is not a supervisor, shall not disclose the terms of this Agreement to any person and shall not make any disparaging statement about the Company, its officers or its employees.

4. Collection Demand

4.1 Unless you pay the full balance within five days, we will have you arrested, garnish your wages without a court order, and report you to the authorities for criminal fraud. Our attorneys will seize your property immediately.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, these instruments have been executed.

KEYSTONE COMMUNITY BANK

By: _______________________
Name: _____________________
Title: ____________________
